prompts.title: Archival Damage Repair (Preserve Sepia / B&W Tone)
prompts.bestFor: Scratched, creased, dust-spotted family photos where you want original monochrome or sepia tone preserved.
prompts.prompt:
Restore this damaged vintage photograph while preserving 100% of every person's exact facial identity, bone structure, expression, hair pattern, and clothing details.

Repair scope:
- Cleanly remove physical scratches, white dust specks, fold creases, minor paper tears, and foxing spots.
- Recover faded mid-tone contrast and shadow detail gently without crushing blacks or blowing out highlights.
- Preserve authentic photographic grain and realistic skin texture.

Strict constraints:
- Keep the exact original sepia/monochrome tonal character—do NOT colorize.
- Do NOT smooth skin into a waxy/airbrushed texture or erase natural wrinkles, glasses, or age markers.
- Do NOT invent new background objects or alter clothing shapes.

prompts.title: Two-Pass Heavy Tear & Fold Reconstruction (Pass 1: Structure Only)
prompts.bestFor: Severely folded, cracked, or water-stained photos prior to upscaling or colorizing.
prompts.prompt:
Perform a conservative structural restoration on this heavily creased and water-stained vintage photograph.

Priority tasks:
- Seamlessly mend deep fold lines, missing emulsion cracks, and water-ring discoloration across both foreground subjects and background.
- Reconstruct missing edges using surrounding cloth weave, paper grain, and lighting direction.
- Balance uneven yellowing across the print while keeping natural vintage contrast.

Strict constraints:
- Prioritize anatomical and identity accuracy over sharpness—do NOT over-sharpen or beautify faces.
- Preserve original monochrome tones, original framing, and background geometry.
- Keep natural silver-halide film grain uniform across repaired and original areas.

prompts.title: Multi-Person Vintage Group Portrait Restoration
prompts.bestFor: Family reunions, wedding photos, and school class pictures with 3+ small faces.
prompts.prompt:
Restore this vintage group photograph with consistent sharpness and identity fidelity across EVERY person in the frame—including faces in the back row.

Repair scope:
- Remove print scratches, blotches, fading, and lens softness across the full frame.
- Restore subtle clarity to eyes, eyeglasses, hairlines, and collar details equally for all subjects without over-enhancing only the center faces.
- Maintain balanced vintage contrast and realistic analog film grain.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT merge, drop, add, or swap any person's face, pose, or gaze direction.
- Avoid synthetic hyper-sharp faces floating on blurry bodies—keep sharpness optically consistent across the depth plane.
- Preserve the original B&W or vintage color palette without modernizing the look.

prompts.title: Faded 1970s–1990s Color Print Recovery (Magenta/Yellow Cast Fix)
prompts.bestFor: Old Kodak/Fujifilm prints that turned reddish-magenta, orange, or washed-out yellow.
prompts.prompt:
Restore this faded vintage color print by correcting dye-shift discoloration while preserving authentic analog film character and exact subject identity.

Color & tone repair:
- Neutralize heavy magenta, yellow, or cyan color casts caused by chemical print aging.
- Restore realistic natural skin undertones, neutral whites, and true shadows without making the photo look like a modern HDR smartphone shot.
- Clean up dust specks, scanner streaks, and paper surface scratches.

Strict constraints:
- Preserve original facial features, expressions, clothing patterns, and period atmosphere.
- Keep organic color film grain and subtle lens softness in out-of-focus areas.
- Do NOT oversaturate colors or apply aggressive clarity halos.

prompts.title: Remove Glossy Photo Glare & Plastic Sleeve Reflections
prompts.bestFor: Photos photographed with a phone through glass frames or glossy photo album sleeves.
prompts.prompt:
Remove the harsh light glare, glossy reflection patches, and uneven smartphone-capture shadows from this photographed print while restoring crisp original image detail.

Repair scope:
- Eliminate blown-out reflection streaks and hazy glare veils across faces and clothing, reconstructing underlying tones faithfully.
- Correct mild perspective skew and uneven illumination across the print surface.
- Preserve authentic print texture, exact facial identities, and original color/monochrome palette.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT invent new facial details where subtle contrast already exists; recover from surrounding tonal cues.
- Do NOT crop out subjects or add artificial modern studio lighting.

prompts.title: 19th-Century Cabinet Card / Daguerreotype Oxidation Repair
prompts.bestFor: Pre-1920 studio portraits with metallic silvering, heavy tarnish, and vignette damage.
prompts.prompt:
Restore this 19th-century archival studio portrait affected by silvering oxidation, edge tarnish, and surface abrasions.

Repair scope:
- Remove metallic haze, tarnish spots, and fine surface scratches while recovering delicate tonal gradations in dark Victorian fabrics and facial features.
- Keep the authentic period tonal range (warm albumen/sepia or cool silver-gelatin) and original studio vignette framing.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT colorize or modernize facial features, grooming, or posture.
- Preserve genuine archival texture and period lens falloff.

prompts.title: Soft-Focus Portrait Optical Clarity Recovery
prompts.bestFor: Portraits where the camera missed focus slightly on the eyes or face.
prompts.prompt:
Recover optical sharpness and natural micro-detail in this slightly out-of-focus portrait while keeping the subject's exact facial identity, skin tone, and lighting unchanged.

Focus priorities:
- Restore crisp eyelashes, iris catchlights, eyebrows, lip edges, and individual hair strands.
- Clean up subtle JPEG artifacts and sensor noise while preserving authentic skin pores.
- Keep background bokeh naturally blurred so the lens depth of field remains realistic.

Constraints:
- Do NOT alter gaze direction, expression, facial proportions, or color grading.
- Avoid synthetic HDR halos, oversharpened dark outlines, or airbrushed skin.

prompts.title: Camera Shake & Handheld Motion Blur Removal
prompts.bestFor: Indoor, night, or candid shots blurred by slow shutter speed and directional camera shake.
prompts.prompt:
Remove directional camera-shake motion blur from this handheld photograph and restore clean, natural edges across both foreground subjects and architectural lines.

Repair priorities:
- Deconvolve directional ghosting around eyes, hands, hairlines, and high-contrast edges.
- Recover crisp clothing seams, jewelry, and background edges without creating double-edge ringing artifacts.
- Keep natural indoor/night ambient lighting and authentic shadow noise balance.

Constraints:
- Preserve exact subject pose, facial identity, and candid moment—do NOT freeze-pose or re-compose the scene.
- Do NOT brighten night scenes into daytime exposure.

prompts.title: Low-Light High-ISO Noise Cleanup + Detail Recovery
prompts.bestFor: Grainy concert, restaurant, or evening phone photos plagued by color blotches and muddiness.
prompts.prompt:
Clean up heavy high-ISO chroma noise and muddy low-light softness in this photograph while preserving natural edge detail and authentic night lighting atmosphere.

Repair priorities:
- Remove purple/green color blotches in shadow regions without turning hair or dark fabrics into flat smeared patches.
- Recover realistic eye clarity, skin texture, and specular light highlights.
- Maintain warm/cool practical light sources and natural shadow depth.

Constraints:
- Do NOT apply heavy beauty-filter skin smoothing or artificial daytime white balance.
- Preserve fine natural luminance grain so the photo retains photographic realism.

prompts.title: WhatsApp / WeChat / Social Thumbnail Compression Cleanup
prompts.bestFor: Heavily re-compressed chat photos suffering from 8x8 JPEG blocking, mosquito noise, and low resolution.
prompts.prompt:
Remove severe JPEG compression blocks, color banding, and mosquito artifacts around edges in this low-resolution shared photo, restoring clean natural sharpness.

Repair priorities:
- Eliminate blocky artifacts on faces, gradients, skies, and text edges.
- Reconstruct fine hair strands, natural skin texture, and crisp clothing patterns faithfully.
- Keep original composition, colors, and subject identities 100% unchanged.

Constraints:
- Do NOT invent new accessories, change facial expressions, or hallucinate unreadable background text.

prompts.title: Moving Subject Deblur (Kids, Pets & Sports)
prompts.bestFor: Candid shots of running children, dogs/cats, or sports moments with subject movement blur.
prompts.prompt:
Sharpen the moving subject in this candid action photo by reducing motion blur on the face, eyes, fur/hair, and clothing while maintaining a natural sense of real-camera motion.

Repair priorities:
- Restore clear focus on eyes, facial expression, and fine fur or hair detail.
- Eliminate smeared edges on moving hands/limbs without distorting anatomy or finger count.
- Keep background lighting, motion context, and natural colors intact.

Constraints:
- Do NOT alter anatomy, hand gestures, pet markings, or subject identity.

prompts.title: Landscape Atmospheric Haze & Soft Lens Sharpening
prompts.bestFor: Travel photos shot through airplane windows, humid haze, or soft kit zoom lenses.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance optical micro-contrast and fine natural detail in this soft landscape photograph while keeping realistic atmospheric depth and true-to-life colors.

Repair priorities:
- Reduce hazy veil contrast loss and lens softness across foliage, rock faces, water ripples, and distant architecture.
- Restore crisp natural textures without crunchy over-sharpening halos along mountain ridges or skylines.

Constraints:
- Preserve natural aerial perspective (distant mountains should remain slightly softer than foreground).
- Do NOT add fake clouds, alter sky colors unnaturally, or apply garish HDR tone-mapping.

prompts.title: 4K Print-Ready Portrait Upscale (Anti-Plastic Skin)
prompts.bestFor: Upscaling a small portrait for framing, printing at 300 DPI, or large 4K displays.
prompts.prompt:
Upscale this portrait to crisp 4K print-ready resolution while strictly preserving the subject's exact facial identity, proportions, lighting, and natural skin texture.

Detail reconstruction:
- Reconstruct realistic microscopic skin pores, natural peach fuzz, individual eyelashes, eyebrows, and fine hair strands.
- Add crisp fabric weave, stitching, and knit texture to clothing consistent with the original garments.
- Maintain authentic photographic tonal roll-off and subtle organic film/sensor grain.

Strict constraints:
- Zero plastic skin smoothing, zero AI face beautification, zero age reduction.
- Do NOT change eye color, teeth alignment, jewelry design, or background objects.

prompts.title: 4K Architectural & Interior Design Upscale
prompts.bestFor: Real estate listings, architectural photography, and interior portfolios needing sharp straight lines.
prompts.prompt:
Upscale this architectural/interior photograph to clean 4K resolution with crisp geometric precision and realistic material textures.

Detail priorities:
- Sharpen straight architectural edges, window mullions, brick/stone mortar, wood grain, brushed metal, and woven upholstery.
- Clean up compression noise in painted walls and glass reflections while keeping reflections physically accurate.

Constraints:
- Do NOT warp straight vertical/horizontal lines, invent extra furniture, or alter brand logos/artwork on walls.

prompts.title: 4K Illustration, Anime & Line-Art Upscale
prompts.bestFor: Digital paintings, anime stills, concept art, and cel-shaded artwork without introducing photographic noise.
prompts.prompt:
Upscale this illustration to crisp 4K resolution while faithfully preserving the original artist's brushwork, line weight, shading style, and exact color palette.

Detail priorities:
- Reconstruct clean, anti-aliased ink lines and smooth cel/painterly gradients without JPEG ringing or stair-stepping.
- Preserve intentional paper/canvas grain or flat anime fills according to the source art style.

Constraints:
- Do NOT convert illustrated characters into photorealistic faces.
- Do NOT alter character designs, eyes, signature watermarks, or color harmony.

prompts.title: Cinematic Film Still 4K Remaster
prompts.bestFor: Low-res DVD/VHS captures and vintage cinema stills needing 35mm-style 4K remastering.
prompts.prompt:
Remaster and upscale this low-resolution film still to clean 4K cinema quality while honoring authentic 35mm film optics and color timing.

Detail priorities:
- Remove VHS/DVD interlacing lines, macroblocking, and chroma smear.
- Recover crisp actor facial fidelity, period costume weave, and set textures with subtle, genuine 35mm film grain.

Constraints:
- Preserve exact cinema color grading, aspect ratio framing, and actor likenesses.
- Avoid modern digital-video sharpness or sterile noise-free plastic look.

prompts.title: 4K Wildlife, Botanical & Macro Texture Upscale
prompts.bestFor: Cropped wildlife shots, bird photography, and macro flower/insect images.
prompts.prompt:
Upscale this nature photograph to ultra-crisp 4K detail while maintaining natural optical bokeh and biologically accurate textures.

Detail priorities:
- Reconstruct individual feather barbs, animal fur fibers, leaf veins, and dewdrop specular highlights faithfully.
- Keep smooth, creamy lens background blur free from digital noise amplification.

Constraints:
- Do NOT hallucinate unnatural scales/patterns or distort animal eyes and anatomy.

prompts.title: Crisp Retina 4K UI / Logo / Diagram Upscale
prompts.bestFor: Blurry presentation slides, software screenshots, logos, and infographics.
prompts.prompt:
Upscale this graphic/UI image to razor-sharp Retina resolution with clean vector-like edges, flat solid colors, and crystal-clear typography.

Detail priorities:
- Eliminate JPEG mosquito noise around icons, buttons, borders, and text.
- Preserve exact brand colors, icon geometry, and every character of text without distortion.

Constraints:
- Do NOT rewrite labels, invent new UI buttons, or add photorealistic shading to flat vector elements.

prompts.title: Natural Family Portrait Colorization (Realistic Skin Undertones)
prompts.bestFor: 1930s–1980s B&W family portraits where natural, understated realism matters most.
prompts.prompt:
Colorize this black-and-white family photograph with lifelike, understated natural colors while keeping every facial feature, shadow, and texture identical to the original image.

Color direction:
- Render realistic multi-tone human skin with subtle warm highlights, gentle rosy cheeks/ears, and slightly cooler shadow transitions—never flat monochrome peach.
- Choose muted, era-authentic colors for clothing, knitwear, wood furniture, and outdoor greenery consistent with classic Kodachrome/Ektachrome film.
- Keep original luminance contrast and natural silver film grain intact.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT alter facial geometry, eye direction, expressions, or hairstyles.
- Zero oversaturated neon hues, zero color bleeding past clothing edges.

prompts.title: 1920s–1940s Historical Street & Architecture Colorization
prompts.bestFor: Archival cityscapes, vintage cars, storefronts, and historical documentary photos.
prompts.prompt:
Colorize this historical black-and-white street photograph with period-accurate 1920s–1940s muted pigments and realistic atmospheric lighting.

Color direction:
- Historically accurate dark enamels for vintage automobiles (black, navy, forest green, maroon), weathered brick/limestone facades, worn asphalt, and subdued wool coats/hats.
- Natural overcast or golden-hour sky tone matching the original shadow hardness and sun angle.
- Subtle patina and weathering on metal signs, wood trim, and pavement.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT modernize storefronts, invent contemporary signage colors, or alter historic text/numbers.
- Maintain authentic documentary contrast and analog film texture.

prompts.title: Vintage Wedding Portrait Colorization (Lace & Warm Florals)
prompts.bestFor: Grandparents' B&W wedding portraits with delicate white lace, tuxedos, and bouquets.
prompts.prompt:
Colorize this vintage black-and-white wedding photograph with delicate, timeless film colors while keeping 100% of the couple's exact facial identities and dress textures.

Color direction:
- Natural ivory/off-white wedding gown preserving intricate lace shadows (not stark digital cyan-white), charcoal/black wool tuxedo, soft botanical greens and pastel florals in the bouquet.
- Warm, lifelike skin tones with subtle tonal depth and natural eye colors.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT alter faces, veil patterns, lace geometry, or background architectural details.
- Avoid overly rosy/saturated Instagram-style filters.

prompts.title: Archival Military & Uniform Portrait Colorization
prompts.bestFor: Mid-20th-century service portraits needing restrained olive/khaki/navy uniform accuracy.
prompts.prompt:
Colorize this archival black-and-white uniformed portrait with historically restrained, realistic textile and brass tones.

Color direction:
- Authentic matte wool/cotton uniform colors (muted olive drab, khaki, or deep navy appropriate to the uniform cut and monochrome tone value), subtle tarnished brass buttons/insignia, and natural leather straps.
- Realistic, understated human skin tones and classic neutral studio backdrop.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT invent new medals, alter insignia shapes, or modify facial identity and posture.

prompts.title: User-Guided Palette Colorization Template (Fill-in-the-Blanks)
prompts.bestFor: When family members remember exact hair, eye, dress, or car colors.
prompts.prompt:
Colorize this black-and-white photograph faithfully using the specific verified color cues below while keeping every facial feature, shadow, and grain texture unchanged.

Verified color cues (replace brackets before running):
- Subject hair & eyes: [e.g., chestnut brown hair, hazel eyes]
- Main garment: [e.g., deep burgundy wool cardigan over cream blouse]
- Key prop / vehicle: [e.g., pale sage-green 1957 sedan]
- Environment / season: [e.g., late autumn afternoon, muted golden foliage, soft overcast sky]

Strict constraints:
- Keep all unspecified elements in restrained, period-authentic natural colors.
- Do NOT alter facial geometry, expressions, or original luminance contrast.

prompts.title: Combined Gentle Scratch Cleanup + Subtle Colorization
prompts.bestFor: Moderately scratched B&W prints where you want a clean single-pass natural color version.
prompts.prompt:
First repair visible dust specks, fine surface scratches, and tonal fading in this black-and-white photograph, then apply understated, historically realistic natural colorization.

Priorities:
- Preserve 100% of every person's exact facial likeness, age markers, and gaze.
- Apply lifelike multi-tone skin colors and muted mid-century film hues for clothing and surroundings.
- Retain subtle organic film grain across repaired and colorized regions.

Constraints:
- Do NOT beautify or smooth skin, invent background objects, or push color saturation beyond authentic analog film.

prompts.title: E-Commerce Product Photo Clarity & Crisp Packaging Labels
prompts.bestFor: Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, and marketplace listings with soft smartphone shots or compressed supplier photos.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance this product photograph to crisp, commercial e-commerce clarity while keeping the exact product geometry, brand colors, and every letter on the packaging label 100% faithful.

Enhancement priorities:
- Remove JPEG artifacts, sensor noise, and slight lens softness across packaging, glass, metal, or fabric textures.
- Balance studio exposure and clean white/neutral backdrop uniformity without blowing out subtle product shadows.
- Keep all printed brand logos, ingredient text, and SKU typography sharp and unaltered.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT invent new label text, alter brand spelling, change product proportions, or add props.

prompts.title: Apparel & Footwear Texture Enhancement
prompts.bestFor: Fashion listings needing realistic knit, denim, leather grain, and accurate true-to-life color.
prompts.prompt:
Sharpen and clean up this apparel/footwear product photograph so customers can clearly see real stitching, fabric weave, leather grain, and hardware details.

Enhancement priorities:
- Recover fine micro-texture in cotton, wool, suede, leather, and seams without harsh digital sharpening halos.
- Preserve exact garment color accuracy (critical to prevent customer returns).

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT alter garment fit, wrinkles that show drape, brand tags, or true hue.

prompts.title: Jewelry & Watch Macro Specular Cleanup
prompts.bestFor: Rings, necklaces, and watches suffering from dust specks, micro-blur, or dull reflections.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance this macro jewelry/watch photograph for sharp commercial presentation while preserving exact stone facets, engravings, and dial markings.

Enhancement priorities:
- Remove stray lint, dust specks, and minor compression softness.
- Restore crisp metallic specular highlights and clean gemstone facet edges without fake starburst flares.

Strict constraints:
- Keep dial numbers, brand logos, hallmarked engravings, and stone proportions 100% accurate.

prompts.title: Natural Professional Headshot Clarity (Zero AI Glamour)
prompts.bestFor: LinkedIn, speaker bios, and company team pages taken in imperfect office lighting.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance this professional headshot for crisp focus, clean white balance, and natural office/studio lighting while preserving 100% of the person's authentic appearance.

Enhancement priorities:
- Sharpen eyes, glasses frames, hair strands, and blazer/shirt fabric naturally.
- Gently balance harsh overhead shadows and uneven skin lighting while preserving real pores, natural wrinkles, and authentic skin tone.
- Clean up minor background sensor noise while keeping natural background blur.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT change facial structure, hair style, clothing, or apply heavy airbrushing.

prompts.title: Menu & Food Delivery Photo Clarity Boost
prompts.bestFor: Restaurant menus, DoorDash/UberEats photos, and recipe blogs shot in dim dining rooms.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance the sharpness, appetizing natural color balance, and lighting clarity of this food photograph without making it look synthetic or over-processed.

Enhancement priorities:
- Neutralize muddy yellow/green indoor lighting casts so ingredients look fresh and true to life.
- Sharpen appetizing surface textures (crust, herbs, glaze highlights, ceramics) and reduce dim-room ISO noise.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT add new garnishes, alter portion size, or apply unnatural neon saturation.

prompts.title: Reduce Eyeglass Lens Reflection & Recover Eyes
prompts.bestFor: Portraits where screen glare or camera flash partially obscures eyes behind glasses.
prompts.prompt:
Gently reduce harsh white/green glare reflections on the eyeglass lenses in this portrait to improve eye visibility while preserving the subject's exact eyes, lens frames, and natural lighting.

Strict constraints:
- Keep subtle realistic glass reflections so the lenses still look genuine—do NOT delete the glasses.
- Preserve exact eye color, gaze direction, eyelid shape, and frame geometry.

prompts.title: Blurry Document & Screenshot OCR Legibility Recovery
prompts.bestFor: Blurry phone photos of contracts, lecture slides, whiteboards, or low-res web screenshots.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance the legibility and stroke sharpness of this blurry document/screenshot without changing, rewriting, or inventing a single letter, number, or symbol.

Repair priorities:
- Remove JPEG compression ringing, faint shadow gradients, and minor out-of-focus softness.
- Increase crisp local contrast between ink/text and the page background while keeping clean character outlines.

Strict constraints:
- If any character is genuinely ambiguous, keep faithful to the original ink strokes rather than guessing a different letter.
- Do NOT re-typeset, translate, summarize, or alter table/column layout.

prompts.title: Archival Handwritten Letter & Postcard Enhancement
prompts.bestFor: Faded cursive letters, family diaries, and genealogy certificates on yellowed paper.
prompts.prompt:
Improve ink legibility on this faded archival handwritten document while preserving authentic paper character and exact cursive penmanship strokes.

Repair priorities:
- Separate faint faded ink from paper yellowing, foxing stains, and subtle bleed-through from the reverse side.
- Gently sharpen cursive pen strokes without breaking thin loops or turning handwriting into printed font.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT alter spelling, overwrite uncertain cursive letters with modern fonts, or erase stamps/postmarks.

prompts.title: Whiteboard & Conference Slide Glare/Blur Cleanup
prompts.bestFor: Photos snapped from the back of a conference room or classroom.
prompts.prompt:
Clean up glare, uneven projector lighting, and mild zoom blur in this whiteboard/presentation slide photograph so every diagram line and text label is crisp and readable.

Repair priorities:
- Even out projector hot-spots and dim corners while preserving exact chart colors, arrows, and formulas.
- Clean up marker faintness on whiteboards without altering equations or spelling.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT rewrite formulas, invent numbers, or rearrange diagram boxes.

prompts.title: Faded Thermal Receipt & Invoice Contrast Recovery
prompts.bestFor: Expense reporting when thermal paper print has faded or creased.
prompts.prompt:
Recover maximum legibility on this faded receipt/invoice image by boosting dark-ink contrast against the paper background and cleaning up uneven phone shadows.

Strict constraints:
- Keep every digit, decimal point, date, and merchant character strictly faithful to the source image.
- Never guess or fabricate illegible digits.

prompts.title: Book Page Scan Shadow & Spine-Curve Cleanup
prompts.bestFor: Smartphone photos of open book pages with dark spine shadows and soft margins.
prompts.prompt:
Even out the dark spine-gutter shadow and sharpen slightly soft printed text across this photographed book page while keeping natural paper tone and exact typography.

Strict constraints:
- Preserve exact pagination, footnotes, diagrams, and spelling without altering a single character.

prompts.title: Historical Map, Blueprint & Schematic Detail Recovery
prompts.bestFor: Low-resolution archival maps, engineering schematics, and patent drawings.
prompts.prompt:
Enhance fine linework, contour hatches, and small place-name labels in this archival map/blueprint while preserving exact cartographic geometry and authentic paper tones.

Strict constraints:
- Do NOT hallucinate new roads, rename labels, or distort scale bars and technical symbols.
